miniProject.title: IO-aware attention with paged decode and fused transformer paths
miniProject.brief: Build IO-aware attention with paged decoding and fused transformer paths, each gated on a dense reference and the public suites before any timing. The attention kernels, paged decode and fused paths feed the endpoint and the final report.
steps: Write the attention IO and FLOP ledger for one prefill and one decode shape you choose, naming byte categories you leave out, with a schedule sketch. Check the budget against event timings and `cuobjdump -res-usage`, and pass LeetGPU challenge 6 in your own harness.

Implement online-softmax tiling in PyTorch, then Triton, checked against a float64 dense reference on odd shapes and tile sizes you choose. Pass the CS336 `flash_forward` tests before timing anything.
Add causal masking and grouped KV heads. Show that changing a future token leaves earlier outputs unchanged, and pass TensorTonic `causal_gqa` and LeetGPU 53.
Optional: implement the backward pass and match autograd in float64 for all three gradients, with causal masking included.

Build a paged decode kernel with a contiguous gather as the reference. Test page permutation, partial pages and request isolation, with KV append, layout conversion, sentinel and stream-order checks, plus optional dequantized loads.

Fuse norm, RoPE and the MLP epilogue, and count the intermediate traffic the fusion removes. Benchmark against eager and compiled SDPA with event timings, adding `sudo ncu` counters where you have access, and keep one regime where your kernel loses.
deliverables: Tiled attention with masks, the IO ledger, tile budget and optional backward, checked against dense references.
Paged decode path with gather oracle, KV append, layout conversion and isolation tests.
Fused norm, RoPE and MLP paths with traffic counts and the baseline sweep with a losing regime.

checks.name: LeetGPU attention challenges against the reference implementation
checks.note: Pass 6 Softmax Attention, 53 Causal Attention, 61 RoPE and 84 SwiGLU MLP Block in your own harness; keep tests beyond the hosted score.

checks.name: CS336 Assignment 2 attention tests
checks.note: Run `flash_forward`, `flash_backward` and `flash_benchmarking` in `tests/test_attention.py` on shapes that fit your GPU's memory.

rubric.pass: Tiled softmax, causal and grouped masks and paged gather each match dense or framework references from your own tests, with future-token and permutation checks passing.
rubric.strong: Closed-book notes rederive the tile merge and the grid size.

rubric.pass: Fused norm, RoPE and MLP paths match separate execution in your own tests, with removed traffic counted at its dtype.
rubric.strong: Diagrams name every buffer fusion removes and one it cannot, with the dtype of each.

rubric.pass: Variants are gated on the public suites before timing, runner metrics stay separate from endpoint metrics, and one losing regime is kept with an explanation.
rubric.strong: The report states when the library or compiler path wins and why.

miniProject.feedsInto: Capstone kernel suite and integration: attention, paged decode, KV kernels and fused paths feed the endpoint. The IO ledger and losing regimes feed the final workload-weighted report.
